card.name: Small words after a verb before a destination
card.fires_on: Short linking words (into, on, to, from, be, in, back) that follow a verb or noun and come right before the place, person or thing something is moving toward or attached to.

modes.label: Prepositions of direction or dependence
modes.description: A preposition after a verb or noun, just before a target such as a person, place or object.
modes.example: Sloths can remain dependant<< on>> their mothers for up to a year.

modes.label: Auxiliary or particle before a covering or state
modes.description: A small word like be or back that comes just before a participle or destination phrase.
modes.example: The area of application should be limited to the area that will<< be>> covered by a short sleeve t-shirt.

modes.label: Movement away or into
modes.description: A preposition of motion that comes just before the thing being entered or left.
modes.example: the black hole is belching its next meals<< into>> oblivion!”

card.writes: It slightly favors words about meeting, crossing and flowing (路过, intersect, 相遇, 流入) and disfavors words about management and abandonment.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words like on, to, from and into that come just before where or whom something is headed.
